title: The Leeward Compass
author: Z. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Mirabel Nystrom, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
